tools.name: visualping_describe_account
tools.description: Describe the connected Visualping account: user id, organisation, plan and credit balances, and the workspaces with their ids. Call it first to find a workspace_id. Account API: GET /describe-user.

tools.name: visualping_list_jobs
tools.description: List the monitoring jobs (page monitors) in a workspace: URL, description, status, interval, last run and next run. Filter by status, monitor mode, labels, recent events or text. Jobs API: GET /v2/jobs.

tools.name: visualping_get_job
tools.description: Get one monitoring job with its settings, next run, and history. The changes list holds detected changes with an AI summary and the diff link. Jobs API: GET /v2/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: visualping_list_labels
tools.description: List the labels of the organisation. Labels group jobs; use their ids in list and create filters. Set compute_usage to count the jobs per label. Jobs API: GET /v2/jobs/labels.

tools.name: visualping_list_activity
tools.description: List the activity feed of a workspace: recent check runs across all jobs, newest first, with job id, URL, and check time. Set include_errors to add failed checks. Jobs API: POST /v2/jobs/report-page.

tools.name: visualping_create_job
tools.description: Create a job that checks a page on an interval and reports changes. It starts active unless active is false. Jobs API: POST /v2/jobs.

tools.name: visualping_update_job
tools.description: Change a job. Send only the fields to change: set active to false to pause a job, true to resume it. Repeating the same change has no further effect. Jobs API: PUT /v2/jobs/{jobId}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: visualping_list_jobs, visualping_list_activity · Public sink: visualping_list_activity, visualping_create_job, visualping_update_job · Destructive: visualping_list_jobs, visualping_get_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: visualping_list_jobs, visualping_list_activity · Public sink: visualping_list_activity, visualping_create_job, visualping_update_job · Destructive: visualping_list_jobs, visualping_get_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
